common.openLinkInBrowser: If the button doesn’t open, copy this address into your browser:
common.useLink: Or confirm with the button below.
common.notYou: If you didn’t ask for this, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.
common.footer: Rishta · a discreet email. We never name anyone in a subject line. You can choose which emails we send in Settings.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.headline: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.body: Please confirm this address so we can send you letters and answers. A page can only be confirmed or published from a confirmed address.

forgotPassword.subject: Choose a new password
forgotPassword.headline: Choose a new password
forgotPassword.body: Someone, we hope you, asked to reset the password for your Rishta account. The link below works once and expires soon.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for Rishta
magicLink.headline: Your sign-in link
magicLink.body: Here is the link you asked for. It signs you in to Rishta and works once.

newUser.subject: Welcome to Rishta
newUser.headline: Welcome to Rishta
newUser.body: Thank you for joining. Please confirm your email address to begin your page. Nothing about you is visible to anyone until you publish it.

organizationInvitation.subject: You’ve been invited to a household on Rishta
organizationInvitation.headline: Join {organizationName}’s household
organizationInvitation.body: {inviterName} has asked you to help with {organizationName}’s search on Rishta. In a household you read pages, keep them and leave pencil notes in the margin: Proceed, Let’s talk or Not for us. Only {organizationName} can write to someone or say yes, and nobody in the household reads their letters.
organizationInvitation.claimSubject: Someone in your family has started a page for you
organizationInvitation.claimHeadline: {inviterName} has started a page for you
organizationInvitation.claimBody: {inviterName} has begun writing a biodata page for you on Rishta. Nothing about you is visible to anyone until you read it and confirm it. If you would rather not have a page, you can decline, kindly.

LETTER_RECEIVED.headline: A letter is waiting for you

LETTER_ANSWERED_YES.headline: Your letter has an answer
LETTER_ANSWERED_YES.message: Your letter has an answer. The seals are broken.

FAMILY_REACTION.headline: A note from your family
FAMILY_REACTION.message: {author} left a pencil note on a page.

CLAIM_REQUESTED.headline: Someone in your family has started a page for you
CLAIM_REQUESTED.message: Nothing about you is visible to anyone until you confirm it.

CLAIM_DECLINED.headline: About the page you started
CLAIM_DECLINED.message: {name} would rather not have a page. Thank you for caring.

defaults.declineNote: Thank you for writing. I don't think we're right for each other, and I wish you well in your search.
defaults.closingNote: Thank you for our conversations. I've decided not to continue, and I wish you well.
defaults.searchClosedNote: I've closed my search. Thank you, and I wish you well.

familyLink.shareText: {name} would like your thoughts on a page: {url}

call.summary: A first call, arranged on Rishta
call.description: Your first call. Rishta keeps contact sealed until you each choose to share it.

firstLine.fallback: I read your page with care, and I'd like to know more about you and your family.

self.parents: My father is {father}, and my mother is {mother}.
